posts.headline: U.S. Markets Rally as AI Optimism Returns
posts.body: U.S. stocks rebounded Tuesday with the Dow gaining 400+ points (0.9%), S&P 500 up 0.8%, and Nasdaq rising 1.1% as investors recovered from Monday's AI-fueled sell-off. The rally was led by technology shares and supported by strong earnings from Home Depot, which beat estimates and rose nearly 4%. Despite lingering tariff uncertainty, market sentiment improved with the AI trade showing signs of stabilization ahead of Nvidia's earnings tomorrow.

posts.headline: WATCH: Workday & Lucid Reporting After Close Today
posts.body: Workday Inc. (WDAY), a key SaaS stock, reports earnings after market close today with analysts watching closely for AI product adoption metrics. Lucid Group (LCID) also reports Q4 results after the bell, with expectations of a $2.67 loss per share on $459.53M revenue. Both reports could provide insight into enterprise spending and EV market conditions, respectively. Results expected around 4:00-4:30 PM ET.

posts.headline: Home Depot Crushes Estimates, Rallies 4%
posts.body: Home Depot (HD) delivered a much-needed beat, posting Q4 EPS of $2.72 vs. $2.54 estimates on revenue of $38.2B. The home improvement retailer's strong performance, with same-store sales exceeding expectations, boosted home goods sector sentiment. Shares jumped nearly 4% in premarket and continued climbing through the session. Options pricing now suggests the stock could move up to 4% more by week's end. Rival Lowe's (LOW) reports Wednesday.

posts.headline: Keysight Technologies Soars 20% on Blowout Earnings
posts.body: Keysight Technologies (KEYS) surged 20% after delivering a stellar quarterly report that exceeded analyst expectations across revenue and earnings metrics. The test and measurement equipment provider benefited from strong demand in 5G and AI-related infrastructure spending. The breakout performance makes KEYS one of today's top S&P 500 gainers and highlights continued momentum in semiconductor-adjacent plays. The stock's relative strength suggests the AI trade recovery has legs.

posts.headline: Nvidia Earnings Tomorrow: AI Trade's Biggest Test
posts.body: All eyes are on Nvidia's (NVDA) Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings report due Wednesday after market close. The AI chip giant faces heightened scrutiny after nearly 20% decline in 2026, with analysts expecting 62%+ profit growth. Revenue is projected around $57B with EPS near $1.30. Results will serve as the ultimate barometer for AI spending trends and could trigger significant market moves. The stock is up 2.7% heading into the report, while Microsoft and Amazon remain down double-digits for the year.

posts.headline: NVDA Call Options Surge Ahead of Earnings
posts.body: Traders are aggressively positioning for Nvidia's earnings with call option volumes spiking 300% above average. The most active strikes are $150 and $160 calls expiring this Friday, representing bets that the stock will surge post-earnings. Implied volatility is sitting at 85%, pricing in a potential 8-10% swing. Given the stock is down 20% YTD, a strong beat could trigger a massive short-covering rally. Consider risk-defined strategies like call spreads to manage elevated premiums.

posts.headline: AI Recovery & Home Goods Lead Today's Rally
posts.body: Today's market leadership shows two clear themes: 1) AI recovery plays rebounding from last week's sell-off, with semiconductor and software stocks recovering; 2) Home goods/retail strength following HD's beat. The 'Magnificent 7' composition is shifting as Apple (+2.94%) gains on iPhone 17e anticipation while Meta maintains $1.61T market cap. Tariff concerns remain in the background but aren't currently pressuring sentiment. The technical bounce off Monday's lows suggests the correction may be finding a bottom.

posts.headline: Bitcoin Testing Critical $60K Support
posts.body: Bitcoin (BTC) dropped 3.1% to $62,557, threatening to break below the critical $60,000 support level. The cryptocurrency is down 19% for February, its worst month since June 2022, as tariff fears weigh on risk assets. A breach of $60K could trigger liquidations and send BTC toward $52,500. Despite 'digital gold' narrative, BTC continues trading in lockstep with equities, making it vulnerable to market volatility. Watch for correlation spikes with Nasdaq during NVDA earnings.
